blurb: A red box floating over Avenida Paulista, with the best European art collection in the southern hemisphere.

facts.h: A museum lifted off the ground
facts.t: Lina Bo Bardi's building of 1968 hangs from two red frames, leaving a free span of 74 metres below as a public square. Inside, she hung the paintings on glass easels, so you walk among them as in a crowd.

src.n: Wikipedia: São Paulo Museum of Art

facts.t: Among its Van Goghs is The Schoolboy, painted in Arles in 1888 of the postman Roulin's son. MASP also owns works by Renoir and Cézanne.

src.n: Wikipedia: São Paulo Museum of Art
